mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (username, password, real_name, phone, shop_id, role_id, enabled) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{shopId}, #{roleId}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET real_name = #{employee.realName}, phone = #{employee.phone}, shop_id = #{employee.shopId}, role_id = #{employee.roleId}, enabled = #{employee.enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE employee SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, role_name AS roleName, role_code AS roleCode FROM role WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE phone = #{phone}
